record: Valentin "Crow" Hodnepijumal signed the papers with a steady hand. The trench at R-F12 took him in like it takes everyone: without a word.
Valentin "Crow" Hodnepijumal is one of the first hundred to answer the call. He wears the ribbon of the First Wave.
On sentry duty Valentin "Crow" Hodnepijumal watched the wire for six hours. Twice he thought the wire watched back.
soldiers.name: Valentin "Crow" Hodnepijumal

record: Bastian "Owl" Hanka signed the papers with a steady hand. The trench at S-F11 took him in like it takes everyone: without a word.
Bastian "Owl" Hanka is one of the first hundred to answer the call. He wears the ribbon of the First Wave.
A flare lit the Ossuary Wood like noon. Bastian "Owl" Hanka counted the seconds until darkness: eleven.
soldiers.name: Bastian "Owl" Hanka
